outcome: Incidence of uterine fundal pressure (UFP) maneuver
Improved management of delivery regarding UFP
cohort: The participants were obstetric institutions across Japan.
finding: The frequency of uterine fundal pressure (UFP) at delivery significantly declined from 11.2% in 2012 to 9.5% in 2017, although a significant decline in uterine rupture after UFP could not be demonstrated.
mod_finding: Frequencies of UFP per vaginal deliveries significantly declined from 11.2% in 2012 to 9.5% in 2017.
cross-section timing: Data was collected for the years 2012 and 2017.
